'''Territory C2''' was a collection of survival zones on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thrantin]] used by the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]]. It contained the [[Second Jungle Zone]] and the [[Ninth Aquatic Zone]].
